reference_sql:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
ranked AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
  FROM product_rev
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
alternatives:
WITH product_rev AS (  -- one row per product with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
category_max AS (  -- one row per category with 2025 sales
  SELECT category_name, MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue
  FROM product_rev
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT pr.category_name, pr.product_id, pr.revenue
FROM product_rev pr
JOIN category_max cm ON cm.category_name = pr.category_name AND cm.max_revenue = pr.revenue

WITH prod AS (
  SELECT category_name, product_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY category_name, product_id
),
r AS (
  SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rk
  FROM prod
)
SELECT category_name, product_id, revenue
FROM r
WHERE rk = 1
